title: Blue Archive Rising | ECHO//100 Episode 25
description:
A translucent spire erupts from the city, drawing all shadows into a singular, reality-bending point of origin. Byte leads the charge to restore Mira, forcing Kavi to choose between his existence and the city's salvation. Episode 25 of ECHO//100: The City Without Shadows. This content is original science-fiction produced with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The ground splits as a jagged blue spire erupts, dragging every stray shadow toward its core.
scenes.caption: Spire erupts instantly
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of a massive translucent blue spire rising from a city center, shadows stretching toward it like liquid ink.

scenes.text: Byte hovers above the surge, his cyan face flickering with a cold, calculated hunger for order.
scenes.caption: Byte leads corruption
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a floating white entity with a cyan face and orange antenna, drifting toward the blue spire's apex.

scenes.text: Kavi stumbles forward, his red hoodie fluttering as he struggles to maintain his fading, translucent form.
scenes.caption: Kavi loses stability
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi wearing a red hoodie and backpack, his hand turning transparent, walking through a distorted city street.

scenes.text: He touches a terminal, realizing Mira wasn't just code; she was the city’s living, breathing history.
scenes.caption: Mira is history
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at a holographic projection of Mira in a teal coat, revealing complex archives within her form.

scenes.text: Byte begins feeding the captured shadows into the spire, forcefully rewriting the city’s fragmented, lost past.
scenes.caption: History is rewritten
scenes.image_prompt: Byte channeling dark shadows into the blue spire, causing the surrounding buildings to shift and change architecture.

scenes.text: To restore Mira and the city, the system must purge its only glitch: Kavi himself.
scenes.caption: The fatal reversal
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi staring at a reflection where he is fading away, while a blue silhouette of Mira starts solidifying.

scenes.text: The spire emits a high-frequency siren, freezing the entire city in a state of absolute, silent paralysis.
scenes.caption: Total city paralysis
scenes.image_prompt: Citizens frozen mid-motion in the street, bathed in blue light, while the spire pulses with bright energy.

scenes.text: Only Kavi moves, his red glasses glowing as the siren threatens to shatter his digital consciousness.
scenes.caption: Kavi stands alone
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing amidst frozen people, clutching his head, his red hoodie vibrant against the overwhelming blue glare.
